change: Lowered chord detection threshold from 3 to 2 pitch classes, added missing-note inference

details.before: Required 3+ pitch classes → missed chords when Basic Pitch drops notes
details.after: Works with 2 pitch classes, infers missing 3rd note (tries maj3, min3, then perfect5)
details.threshold: 0.75 confidence for inferred chords, 0.5 for 3+ notes
